_comment: Spark X2.5 4B on B-v9 (5 Oct): B-v6n's data (the hard far-field / TV-noise speech-to-text augmentation) plus the 4B B-v2u's 993 verified design-B transcripts of the wild training conversations (B-v4w's addition). Spark B-v6n is the best design-B model typed (84.3% mean on the B sets, 85.5% on the 200-conversation house set); B-v4w lifted Spark's wild sets 3-4 points. Spark B-v2's recipe otherwise.
